it.it: Scusa, dove si trova la panetteria?
it.english: Excuse me, where is the bakery?

it.it: Gira a destra dopo la chiesa
it.english: Turn right after the church
You can't miss it.
Are you new here?
Yes, we come from Paris,

it.it: Parigi! Benvenuti nel nostro quartiere! Qui è più tranquillo rispetto a Parigi.
it.english: Paris! Welcome to our neighborhood! Here, it's quieter than in Paris.
it.ipa:
[parˈiːdʒɪ
 bˌenvenˈuːtɪ nˌɛl nˌɔstro kwˌartiˈɛːre
 kwˈi ˌɛ pjˌʊ trankwˈillo rispˈɛtːo ˌa parˈiːdʒɪ]

it.it: Le persone sono molto gentili qui.
it.english: People are very kind here.

it.it: Sì, è diverso dalla grande città
it.english: Yes, it's different from the big city
Everyone talks to each other here.
What can one do here?
There are many hikes
The mountains are magnificent.
Do you like the mountains?

it.it: Sì, adoriamo la natura. È per questo che siamo venuti.
it.english: Yes, we love nature. That's why we came.
it.ipa:
[sˈi
 ˌadoriˈaːmo lˌa natˈuːra
 ˌɛ pˌɛr kwˌɛsto kˌe sjˌamo venˈuːtɪ]

it.english: Tomorrow, we will go hiking.

it.it: Attenzione, il tempo cambia velocemente qui
it.english: Be careful, the weather changes quickly here

it.it: Portate sempre con voi vestiti caldi.
it.english: Always bring warm clothes with you.
Thank you for the advice,
Have a good evening and good luck!

it.it: Sophie e Lucas camminano per le stradine strette del quartiere.
it.english: Sophie and Lucas walk through the narrow streets of the neighborhood.
it.ipa: [sˈopje ˌe lˈuːkas kˌamminˈaːno pˌɛr lˌe strˈadine strˈetːe dˌɛl kwˌartiˈɛːre]

it.it: Incontrano un vecchio che passeggia con il suo cane.
it.english: They come across an old man walking his dog.
it.ipa: [inkˈontrano ˌʊn vˈekːio kˌe passˈedʒːa kˌon ˌil sˌʊo kˈaːne]

it.english: The man looks at them curiously.
They continue their walk.

it.it: L'odore del pane fresco li accoglie.
it.english: The smell of fresh bread welcomes them.
The baker is very chatty.

it.it: Sophie compra del pane e delle paste.
it.english: Sophie buys some bread and pastries.
it.ipa: [sˈopje kˈompra dˌɛl pˈaːne ˌe dˌɛlle pˈaste]
